mapper.sql: WITH reports AS ( SELECT e.id,e.tenant_id,e.event_type,e.provider,e.model,e.occurred_at,e.invocation_id,e.attempt_id, e.session_id,e.run_id,e.quantity,e.prompt_tokens,e.completion_tokens,e.image_count,e.video_count, e.characters,e.duration_seconds,e.pricing_snapshot_version,e.pricing_model_id,e.pricing_model_revision, e.currency,e.report_revision,e.usage_source FROM public.nw_usage_events e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.event_type IN AND e.usage_event_kind='usage_report' AND e.attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_usage_events m WHERE m.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND m.attempt_id=e.attempt_id AND m.usage_event_kind='measured') ), report_groups AS ( SELECT tenant_id,attempt_id,MIN(occurred_at) AS occurred_at, (array_agg(id ORDER BY report_revision DESC,id DESC))[1] AS metadata_id, (array_agg(prompt_tokens ORDER BY report_revision DESC,id DESC) FILTER(WHERE prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND usage_source='PROVIDER_REPORTED'))[1] AS prompt_tokens, (array_agg(completion_tokens ORDER BY report_revision DESC,id DESC) FILTER(WHERE completion_tokens IS NOT NULL AND usage_source='PROVIDER_REPORTED'))[1] AS completion_tokens FROM reports GROUP BY tenant_id,attempt_id ), facts AS ( SELECT e.id,e.event_type,e.provider,e.model,e.occurred_at,e.invocation_id,e.attempt_id,e.session_id,e.run_id, e.quantity,e.prompt_tokens,e.completion_tokens,e.image_count,e.video_count,e.characters,e.duration_seconds, e.pricing_snapshot_version,e.pricing_model_id,e.pricing_model_revision, e.effective_amount AS original_amount_cents,e.effective_currency AS original_currency, CASE WHEN e.cost_status='priced' THEN e.confirmed_cost_cents END AS amount_cents,e.cost_status FROM public.billing_effective_usage e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.event_type IN AND e.occurred_at>=#{from} AND e.occurred_at<#{to} AND NOT(e.event_type IN ('media.image','media.video','media.transcription','media.speech') AND e.quantity=0 AND e.amount_status='not_applicable') UNION ALL SELECT e.id,e.event_type,e.provider,e.model,g.occurred_at,e.invocation_id,e.attempt_id,e.session_id,e.run_id, e.quantity,g.prompt_tokens,g.completion_tokens,e.image_count,e.video_count,e.characters,e.duration_seconds, e.pricing_snapshot_version,e.pricing_model_id,e.pricing_model_revision, NULL::numeric AS original_amount_cents,e.currency AS original_currency,NULL::numeric AS amount_cents, 'unresolved'::text AS cost_status FROM reports e JOIN report_groups g ON g.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND g.metadata_id=e.id WHERE g.occurred_at>=#{from} AND g.occurred_at<#{to} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS model_calls,COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents),0) AS known_amount_cents, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE cost_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'priced' OR amount_cents IS NULL) AS missing_cost_count, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens,SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens FROM facts

SELECT id,event_type,provider,model,occurred_at,invocation_id,attempt_id,session_id,run_id,quantity, prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,image_count,video_count,characters,duration_seconds, pricing_snapshot_version,pricing_model_id,pricing_model_revision,original_amount_cents,original_currency, amount_cents,cost_status FROM facts ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
